Project Role : Cloud Platform Engineer

Project Role Description : Designs, builds, tests, and deploys cloud application solutions that integrate cloud and non-cloud infrastructure. Can deploy infrastructure and platform environments, creates a proof of architecture to test architecture viability, security and performance.

Must have skills : Site Reliability Engineering

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

As a Cloud Platform Engineer, a typical day involves designing and constructing cloud application solutions that seamlessly integrate both cloud-based and traditional infrastructure. The role includes testing and deploying these solutions to ensure they meet performance and security standards. The engineer also develops infrastructure and platform environments, creating proof of architecture models to validate the feasibility and robustness of the proposed designs. Collaboration with various teams to align architecture with organizational goals and continuous improvement of deployment processes are key aspects of the daily workflow.

Roles & Responsibilities:

 Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. Responsible for team decisions. Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. Lead the evaluation and implementation of new cloud technologies to enhance platform capabilities. Ensure continuous monitoring and optimization of cloud infrastructure for reliability and efficiency. Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and skill development.

Professional & Technical Skills:

 Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Site Reliability Engineering. Experience with cloud infrastructure automation and orchestration tools. Strong knowledge of system monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis. Familiarity with containerization and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes and Docker. Ability to design scalable, secure, and highly available cloud environments. Expertise in scripting and automation using languages such as Python, Bash, or similar.

Additional Information:

 The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering. This position is based at our HDC3B - SEZ location. A 15 years full time education is required.

Project Role : Cloud Services Engineer

Project Role Description : Act as liaison between the client and Accenture operations teams for support and escalations. Communicate service delivery health to all stakeholders and explain any performance issues or risks. Ensure Cloud orchestration and automation capability is operating based on target SLAs with minimal downtime. Hold performance meetings to share performance and consumption data and trends.

Must have skills : Python (Programming Language)

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

In the role of Cloud Services Engineer, a typical day involves serving as the primary point of contact between the client and internal operations teams, ensuring smooth communication and timely resolution of support issues. The role requires monitoring the health of service delivery, identifying and explaining any performance challenges or risks to stakeholders, and maintaining cloud orchestration and automation systems to meet established service level agreements. Regular performance meetings are conducted to review consumption data and trends, fostering transparency and continuous improvement across teams. This position demands proactive coordination and effective management of cloud service operations to minimize downtime and optimize service reliability.

Roles & Responsibilities:

 Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. Responsible for team decisions. Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. Coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure alignment with client expectations and operational goals. Facilitate knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team to enhance overall expertise and performance. Monitor and report on service delivery metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.

Professional & Technical Skills:

 Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Python (Programming Language). Experience with cloud orchestration and automation tools to manage and optimize cloud environments. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex system issues and provide effective solutions. Familiarity with monitoring and performance management tools to track service health and consumption trends. Ability to communicate technical information clearly to diverse stakeholders, including clients and internal teams. Experience working in collaborative environments involving multiple teams and stakeholders.

Additional Information:

 The candidate should have minimum 8 years of experience in Python (Programming Language). This position is based at our HDC3C - SEZ location. A 15 years full time education is required.

Where Ambition Meets Innovation


At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.


Join us as we create something extraordinary together.



Where Ambition Meets Innovation



Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.



LPL's Delivery team is the Cloud Center of Excellence's internal professional-services crew — the engineers who parachute in with white-glove service to get applications to the cloud fast. As Engineer 2, Cloud Delivery Engineer, you'll staff Experience-Based Acceleration (EBA / SBA) and other acceleration events, partner with lean application teams, and build Terraform that operationalizes AWS services and third-party platforms like Confluent Kafka and Kong. If you like shipping real workloads to the cloud with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.

You also help migrate application workloads into the multi-account landing zone. LPL is an AWS-first CCOE: a multi-account landing zone with 100+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You partner with the Platforms and Containers teams, the Support team, and the Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), and you spend the majority of your time hands-on in Terraform and delivery work across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC) — leaving the teams you help able to run what you built together.

grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPsConsume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you usePartner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peersApply the AWS Well-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomesParticipate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependenciesPursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over timeWhat are we looking for?We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well-scoped pull requests against shared modulesDemonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well-scoped engineering work end-to-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow-throughExperience participating in 24x7 production on-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast-paced, security-conscious environment (financial services preferred)Hands-on experience delivering application workloads to AWS in a consulting, professional-services, or platform-delivery capacity — including Infrastructure-as-Code delivery and, ideally, operationalizing a managed AWS service or a third-party system (e.g., Kafka, Kong, or similar) as reusable IaCCore Competencies:Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loopBias toward shipping high-quality, well-tested, code-reviewed work; Our story

At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. At our core, we Champion People, help our colleagues Grow with Purpose and true to our name we encourage colleagues to “Be Alight.”

 

Our Values:

Agility: Move with purpose, learn fast, and adapt quickly.Leadership: Lead by example, own the outcome, and serve others.Integrity: Do the right thing, even when it is difficult or unseen.Growth Mindset: Stay curious, keep learning, and continue improving.High Quality: Do it thoughtfully, completely, and well.Trust: Earn trust through consistency, authenticity, and credibility. 

It’s why we’re so driven to connect passion with purpose. Alight helps clients gain a benefits advantage while building a healthy and financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, absence management and navigation.

 

With a comprehensive total rewards package, continuing education and training, and tremendous potential with a growing global organization, Alight is the perfect place to put your passion to work.

 

Join our team if you Champion People, want to Grow with Purpose through acting with integrity and if you embody the meaning of Be Alight.

 

Learn more at careers.alight.com.

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases and make people's lives easier, fuller, and longer. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting edge of innovation.

Job Description :

Title : DevOps Engineer

Location : India

Remote

Experience: 4+ Years

We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer with 4+ years of experience in designing, implementing, and managing cloud-based infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM templates), version control systems (Git), CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.), and scripting languages such as Python, Shell, or PowerShell is highly preferred. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and collaboration skills are essential.

4+ years of DevOps Engineering experience

Solid knowledge of Kubernetes and Docker

Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.)
